body:
I've always been color blind. When I approach a traffic light, I go on the white light. Not the white light of eternal truth, but rather the green light that looks white to me. I do recall, however, that during several of my more enjoyable acid journeys, particularly about 6 hours into it when I would just be coming down, I was no longer color blind. The trees and the colors of the sky became as others see them, not in a glaring or psychedelic way but more like it is represented in a mural. I certainly wasn't cured of this annoying affliction but, for once in my life I could see the world as others do.
